steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The ritual has no affect on these Sarkaz... But our Sarkaz operators aren't immune? Why?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But they didn't look like they were with the guerrilla team. Strange...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm going on patrol.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't thank me. Like Amiya always says, you don't thank people for doing their jobs.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The effects of the Oripathy inhibitor will take a while to show. But for now, you should be feeling a lot less pain.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Take the medicine back to the others. There isn't much, probably only enough for one dose, but it will help with acute symptoms.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Did you really come to help us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, but we can't help you much more than this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to defeat the leader of Reunion before we can do anything else.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also... if Reunion breaks into a full-scale riot again, I think we won't be able to handle them.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: All those things I said to you... I... I wasn't like this before.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I used to hate you people. But now, I'm like you. Everyone hates me too.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I very nearly killed him. But without his help... we might already be dead.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: But every time he let us go find supplies, someone died. I thought for sure that was proof he was working with Reunion, to toy with us.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Even though we're already Infected? Does Reunion... really hate the Ursus so much?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: People don't need much to indulge in the ugliest side of their nature. Just giving them free rein can contaminate every part of a city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit... you scared me!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, you shouldn't be letting these games get the better of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just once or twice is enough...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'll spoil our plans if you waste so much time talking.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: So... Dr. Kal'tsit, if she lied, were you really going to kill me?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I... I didn't lie though!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Just hypothetically. Not every Infected is so honest after they've been hurt. I've acted on impulse before myself.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Um... *sigh*...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're a Rhodes Island operator. I trust you over all others.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's call it a form of psychological treatment for her. Naturally, the way you and she responded to it proved your innocence.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But I...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That look on your face was so dark and terrifying. I really thought you were going to do it... your act was way too convincing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sounds fine to me. I wouldn't do it, but I'd like to make people think that I would.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, you really pushed it... no more terrorizing Guard.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry, Guard. If she did go too far, I would've stepped in to stop her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did all that spike your emotional state? Should I help you recuperate?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Oh, no need. I'd be awful weak if I needed the Amiya treatment after just that.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: After all... The one I really worry about is the little one standing by the door.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But even that's looking better. She and I sorted things out, and I think I get it... but I still can't let go of the time she split a person clean in half with the sweep of a claymore.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That's gonna be with me my whole life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... I know the incident you're talking about.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard... did you know she saved four civilian lives during that operation? That the military was testing weapons on them?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She killed an abandoned weapons-grade experimental caster they'd bought from a Sargon slaver. The entire batch of casters had their pituitary glands surgically removed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The glands were replaced with an Originium device that kept them moving without input from their own nervous systems. They were already dead.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Only Rosmontis, with her unique fighting style, could destroy the experimental infected organs. She did nothing wrong.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...So that's what happened?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard, I think you misjudged Rosmontis the same way that young lady misjudged you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What you look like, and any rumors going around about you, are anyone's first window into your personality. No matter what you did, they'd be looking at you as Reunion first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But if we never got past the surface... we'd never know anything, let alone learn to trust.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If no one tries to find the truth, then no matter how hard we work to sow its seeds, they won't germinate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And anyway, Rosmontis is right in front of you. Why don't you just... ask her?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: A-Ask her?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What do you want to ask?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Um, not like that... she won't know what to say...)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Rosmontis, what are you here for?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: My mission.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...And, like I said, getting revenge. For my family.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm done asking.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But... I don't even know what I asked.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I was angry at Azazel before, and now I was rude to Rosmontis. Hah, what a mess I am.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But you trust Patriot. Tell us about Patriot and his guerrillas, and about Reunion.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm pretty sure Dr. Kal'tsit and Dr. {@nickname} here can make sense of it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: The only reason there's anyone still left alive, why so many Ursus were able to make it through Chernobog...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Is because Patriot and his guerrillas. And the people who respect them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: When the guerrilla fighters were around, there was peace. Nobody dared to raise a hand against anybody else.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Not only did they hand out supplies and resources, but they even worked to make the locals' lives a little better.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Patriot was going to let me leave the city. But I decided to stay... to see how things turned out.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I overheard him talking to the leader of Azazel. I think even if it's all an act, he's at least working hard to keep up the act.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Also... Mr. Scout died there to protect me. Patriot respected Mr. Scout. I...

options: Scout... was an operator who sacrificed himself in Chernobog.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Scout!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What happened to Scout?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... why can't I remember? He died? He...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: This emptiness... is that him? Scout... I forgot again?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But I just... the terminal... how could I forget again?
January 3rd
An old man with white hair brought a charred, blackened object. Mechanist couldn't stand after seeing it.
The old man nodded and left. Dr. Kal'tsit didn't say anything, only patted my head.
It was Scout's.
Scout.
Scout is gone too.
Scout was the one who didn't even have a shadow, wasn't he? Wouldn't he be the one who came back even when everyone else died? Wasn't he the one with a never-ending story?
Scout......
I searched the logs. Scout made me a bow. But that's a toy for little girls. I don't play with toys anymore.
Why did Scout die?
Why? Why? Why?
Why?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: *sobs*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Give me your hand. Close your eyes, Rosmontis...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Turns out elite operators... aren't that different... from my teammates.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I've got something to say.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: On your rescue operation, Scout led the recon team. He never knew you like you are now... But he said he knew you before, like Ace.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He held back the Sarkaz mercenaries to save my life.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Knowing Scout, he could've easily gotten out if he wanted to.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He told me to tell you something... Right, I remember it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He said he would never forget fighting by your side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He also wanted you to stop being a commander. But things being what they are, I think you probably can't just sit by and watch.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Boss sacrificed himself to save me too. That means I've got two elite operators' lives on my shoulders.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But Mr. Scout said they didn't die for any one person. They died for an idea.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: His team did, and so did mine.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: So I decided to look into Reunion. I had to see where things were going, and how I could help Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: —I saw the guerrillas had their own idea. A firm, pure conviction that they were fighting for.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They were a little more savage, of course, but they never found joy in violence. That's what I saw in them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If Reunion was supposed to be about liberating the Infected, then the guerrillas... they were there to exterminate their oppressors.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They'd exterminate those who enslave the Infected, and those who threaten the common folk. All of them. To a man.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That's because of Patriot. Patriot taught them, led them, and protected them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Before Patriot set out from Chernobog on a mission, I had a... talk with him.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: *Sigh*. Just how old is that warrior? But he still shared some of his booze with me. It was the first time... anybody treated me like that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He may indeed be much older than you think.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Have you heard the legend? About him leaving Ursus?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have. He led an entire elite division out of Ursus. The Great Rebellion proved to be fertile ground for all sorts of things that otherwise would've been absurd.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: The truth is, there aren't many of those soldiers he led out of Ursus left.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Their clashes with the Ursus regulars must've cost them a lot of men.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Most of his guerrillas are fresh recruits, people who volunteered to join when they fought in the northwest tundra.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Their battles, their prestige, and their ideals all won them recruits.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They used to work well with the leader of Reunion. But for some reason, maybe related to the burning hate the Infected have for the people of Ursus... things turned out like this.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: It is what it is. Everyone alive today suffers Catastrophes, madness, and death. All kinds of suffering that this world heaps upon them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Tatiana... I remember your name is Tatiana.

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: ...That's right.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Does your knee hurt?

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Three days ago, you tripped trying to run away.

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: It got better a while ago...! I'm Ursus! I'm not like... whatever your race is. Us Ursus are much sturdier.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm glad... it looked pretty nasty.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Hah, here I am, doing a medic operator's job without any training.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I've got a lot on my plate, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Medic didn't come with you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why bring her up?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I can tell by the look on Rosmontis's face what happened. We've lost a lot of people, but Rhodes Island fights on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm getting the impression that you don't know the core city is on a collision course with Lungmen.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Oh, are you talking about helping the Reunion forces at the battle of Lungmen? Moving the core city is Reunion's only play. I heard about that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The core city is broadcasting an Ursus identification code.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...What?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Hold up!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...No way... That doesn't make any sense!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now you know why we're here.

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: What's the problem?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Makes the Rhodes Island hand gesture for 'quiet.')

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Nothing...

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: ...You've been talking so long. If Patriot and his men are as good as you say, why is Reunion still running amok here in Ursus?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because Reunion 'shouldn't' be doing this.

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think you would be a great help to our operation, since you're familiar with both the local Infected and Reunion. Would you be willing to rejoin our team?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, but you can't leave yet, can you?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Right. I'm sure you can tell just by looking at me. Right, Amiya?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Sorry, I know I'm about a decade older than you, but sometimes you make me feel like a kid.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No need to blame yourself. I could even say Rhodes Island will honor your work.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...But you're in a very dangerous position.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Guard, if Reunion falls here, your work to save the Infected and maintain their basic living conditions will become much more difficult.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you at all worried that could come to pass?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Because Reunion has Patriot.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: As long as he's here, Reunion won't fall.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: A lot of guerrilla fighters left camp and gathered up. I'm thinking that's because he may be back already.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And if he's here, I believe Reunion can still change.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Reunion lacks the impetus to change. Looking at the evidence, Talulah has certainly not devoted herself to the cause.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Chernobog's core city, the ruins of Chernobog back there, and the Ursus Infected...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We can't forget that the Ursus Third Army is still out there waiting to act. That will make everything drastically worse.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But I know Reunion is relatively strong.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And there are a few things... Rhodes Island can't handle. This is one of those things!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Rhodes Island is a corporation. Dr. Kal'tsit has been very clear about that, time and again.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I believe in Boss, and Mr. Scout...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And I believe in Patriot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Aren't you mad, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why should I be mad at you... over things we can't do, and things we haven't done?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So much happened these past two weeks. We've all changed a lot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we're not about to turn on each other because of the Infected. I think all that happened in Chernobog, and what Guard and I saw, were the same.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Correct. I still can't stand hurting people like that. No matter who's doing it to who, I won't stand for it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If Patriot wants to clean house in Reunion, I have to stand with him, with his men, and with all the Reunion members who believe in Patriot.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We do not consider your new way of thinking to be a threat to our interests.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In fact, we encourage all our operators to learn more about the outside world, seek out their own goals, and build their self-confidence.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our ideas are constantly changing.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Thank you, Dr. Kal'tsit, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You can also contact the Doctor later.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: As for my responsibilities at Rhodes Island... Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit... Will they be more important?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I wouldn't put it that way, Guard. It's more important to decide for yourself what you want to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And, personally, I think that any of us would have done the same in your position.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Different people make different choices. If something's important to you, it's important.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope you find a place for yourself among these Ursus, like you wanted. I hope you can protect those deserving of protection.

steps.name: Tatiana
steps.text: ...W-why are you looking at me...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...I'm not. No reason. Just thinking.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Regarding your pay, I'm afraid your work here doesn't support a salary. Sorry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Also, Guard, please do tell me—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Patriot betrays Talulah, what happens then?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...That won't happen. Patriot trusts Talulah deeply.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now what about the other way around?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Dr. Kal'tsit?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What if Talulah betrays Patriot?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or, what if I told you we encountered the Reunion commander, FrostNova, and by any objective measure, are responsible for her death?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit?! What are you saying?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That... th-that's Patriot's daughter...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we fight Patriot...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That would be the worst case scenario. And it's what the puppetmasters would want.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If Talulah really is turning a blind eye to, or even allowing the Infected to harm innocent civilians in spite of Patriot's stance... I believe that's no longer just turning a blind eye.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A lot of Infected will make Patriot into a target. Those who don't know the truth, and those who let their hatred get the better of them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And those who want to.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I... I have to go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I have to tell Patriot!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But... Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Will he be... your enemy?

options: I didn't think things would turn out like this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not the obvious step for Reunion to take.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whether Misha or FrostNova...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Us, Reunion, and Lungmen too... We can't let anyone else slip through the cracks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we still have a lot to do... just thinking of what comes next is making me tired.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But before that... we have to find Madame Ch'en.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And, most importantly...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The leader of Reunion. She's the cause of all of this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right. Team Mantra-2, come in.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The captain has determined Reunion's communication method. It's primitive, even artificial-looking. As for personnel, she's just about done clearing the area.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not the guerrillas though. They're tough.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Should we eliminate them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No need for that. We're not here to eliminate them, or have them butcher each other.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're not here to stir up internal conflict. They should oppose those who misled them.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's her question. I'm good.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Naturally... not now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Their spirit is rotten, but their fabrication of a backbone still remains.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take it away or break it, and watch them crumble. That's what we might have done at first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Talulah was a step ahead of us. She stirred the conflict and fanned its flames.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I originally thought that she had gone mad. But this is poison, not madness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Infected and the people of the city will surely rise up.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Talulah gave them the chance to intermingle and build bridges.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She must still have a queen on the board, or she wouldn't be so bold.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I firmly believe that she wants to destroy Reunion, in the most dishonorable possible way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...And this is a poison that we must neutrallize.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But all this hinges on what Buldrokkas'tee decides to do...

options: It looks like we've successfully infiltrated the core city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because what we do next can hardly be called an infiltration, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As I said when we started, infiltration is only about twenty percent of our plan here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To get to the core command tower and the generator area to halt Chernobog's movement, we will have to go through the central district.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now, the enemies in our path are not your run-of-the-mill Reunion, nor are they brutish Sarkaz sellswords.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's put W aside for now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As a tactician, you should be more concerned about this than about Talulah, Reunion's tyrant.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Infected Guerrillas of the Northern Plains, a thorn in the hinterland of Ursus's Fourth Army to the northwest... Since its formation, it has only ever had one leader.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ordinary resistance fighters get slaughtered, but these guerrillas were able to turn the tables on the butchers.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Local stakeholders could request the mobilization of a division or two to knock them out, but it would be taken as an admission of incompetence to the generals and the State Council.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The war raged for so long that the Infected hiding out in the snow came to call the guerrillas their 'Aegis.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Aegis of the Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Yeti Squad was one of its subsets, and its members did not solely consist of Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The exiles, the fanatics, the maimed, Elves, Durin, and Sarkaz. The guerrillas did not fight for the Infected alone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh?

options: I just said whatever came to mind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just like Rhodes Island, yes?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just as before, Rhodes Island will benefit from your intuition, Dr. {@nickname}.

options: I thought you wouldn't appreciate that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Why do you look into my eyes when you say that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's nothing to see in these eyes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's no point in staying silent at a time like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's your choice whether or not you hold an opinion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Would you rather I didn't?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You want me to reprimand you, Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not now. I don't think you do, and I don't think there's anything wrong with what you said.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In an unexpectedly apt analogy, the guerrilla fighters also trust only one commander, and embrace only that one commander.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, Doctor, this guerrilla force is another sort of 'Rhodes Island.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But their leader? No.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, prepare yourself well. Or you'll regret it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even though one of our objectives is to clear a path through the central district to the bridge and the generator area...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For your own safety, I still hope you and Amiya will not face him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But if this is all inevitable, then I can only repeat what I just said.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Prepare yourself well, Dr. {@nickname}. And before you face him, you must prepare to face his guerrillas.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I rarely offer my advice to others, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But that is 'Patriot,' Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Still... another... block?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: No... No! I have to... I have to tell Patriot...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If Talulah... if Talulah lets these people... strike at the guerrillas...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Then... then... the guerrillas will... they will...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Be killed by their own...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Patriot... Patriot is the only level-headed one left in Reunion...!
Where do you think you're going?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What brigade are you with? And what business do you have in the central district?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Explain it to me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Oh, or maybe you're with the old Wendigo.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: The prey ran right up to me on his own.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What did you learn, weak little Infected outlander?
